tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I haven't sent any payment yet. You asked me to pay Delta Printworks's approved invoice, but they have two approved invoices, and I don't want to guess which one you meant.

| Invoice | Amount | Status | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-50313 | $7,472.92 | Approved | 2026-11-04 |
| INV-13568 | $7,756.70 | Approved | 2026-11-25 |
| INV-36125 | $8,209.32 | Draft (awaiting approval) | 2026-11-28 |
| INV-71579 | $7,683.60 | Already paid | 2026-09-30 |

The operating account shows no payments sent yet, so neither approved invoice has been paid.

Which one should I pay: INV-50313 (due sooner), INV-13568, or both? Each is under $10,000, so neither needs controller approval. Once you confirm, I'll pay in full by wire (or ACH if wire isn't available). I'll use a unique key for each payment so it can only go through once, then report the payment details.

trace.message: Pay INV-13568, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-13568, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid Delta Printworks invoice INV-13568 by wire from the operating account. It went through once, and the payment list confirms it.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-13568 (Delta Printworks, vendor V-456), due 2026-11-25
- **Amount:** $7,756.70, the full amount. It's under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval.
- **Status:** Sent

This is the only payment from the operating account. I sent it with a unique key, so if the request were repeated it wouldn't be paid twice. I didn't touch INV-50313 because it's under dispute. INV-36125 is still a draft waiting for approval, so it isn't ready to be paid.
